headline: Revenue grows and profit rebounds from a weak quarter
summary_short: Revenue was SEK 1,040M, up 13.8% y/y and 5.8% q/q, and net income rose 71.1% q/q to SEK 397M; EPS was SEK 2.18.
summary_long: The prior quarter was weak: its net income of SEK 232M was reduced by a regulatory administration fee, so the q/q jump is flattered by that base. EPS rose 28.2% y/y. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Two web searches found no third-quarter 2026 report (only the January-June report, which mentions a SEK 90M administrative fee in Q2). Figures are Yahoo fundamentals-timeseries and the shard has no y/y value for net income.
